Script downloaded

  1. Open Adobe Illustrator.
  2. Choose File › Scripts › Other Script…
  3. Select the downloaded .jsx file. It builds the print file with the printer’s guides and your artwork.
  4. Check the measurement pop-up, then delete the guide layer before exporting the print PDF.

Nothing downloaded? and save it in a plain-text file ending in .jsx.
